answer_text: Best practice is to implement the guest Wi‑Fi as its own VLAN on the Socket. This gives centralized control from the Cato Management App and lets you isolate quickly (for example, by blocking WAN access or removing the VLAN’s default gateway). If you want a simpler option, you can configure an Internet-only guest SSID so guests reach only the Internet while traffic still passes through the Cato security stack. The KB also notes that guest networks are best separated into their own VLAN to prevent access to internal resources, and VLAN tagging is supported on Sockets for VLAN-enabled ranges.
